description: RemindMe is a simple, but powerful, reminders application for Windows. RemindMe lets you quickly create reminders for relative (ex: "in 10 minutes") or absolute (ex: "3: 00PM on 5/9/2013") times. Watch your reminders count down in real time. RemindMe integrates deeply with Windows 8. Get toast notifications for reminders, see your next reminders on the live tile, sync your reminders across your Windows 8.1 devices, and stay up to date on the lock screen. You can even pin the compose screen to Start to quickly create new reminders. With an amazing, easy-to-use UI and features like live countdow
